workouts.title: Warm up:
workouts.description:
3X
15 Cal Row
10/10 Single Leg Glute Bridge
5 Inchworm
:20 Hanging L-Sit (or :20 Hanging Knee Tuck)

workouts.title: Back Squat:
workouts.description:
Back Squat:
3x8 @ 65% // RPE 6.5

NOTES:
- Rest at least 2:00 between sets.
- Pulling the weight back to deload this week. Take this week as an opportunity to work on perfect positioning for each rep.

workouts.title: Front Squat
workouts.description:
Front Squat:

3x3 @ 70-75% // RPE 6.5

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:30 between sets.
- Same as on the back squats, this week we are pulling the weights/volume back for a deload this week.

workouts.title: Rowing intervals
workouts.description:
Rowing intervals

PRIMER.
2 Sets:
1:00 Row @ Moderate Pace
:30 Row @ Hard Pace
1:00 Row @ Easy Pace
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

MAIN SET.
6 Sets:
500m @ 02:05/500m
Rest 1:30
250m @ 02:01/500m
Rest :45
125m @ Sprint (High Damper)
Rest 2:00 Between Sets

NOTES:
- Now we are really looking to push the pace in our efforts. You should feel more comfortable and confident on the rower, so it's time to start putting some power through the machine.
- Each distance should get progressively faster, but look to be consistent across all six sets.
- If you are using a PM5 monitor, use this link to set your erg and track your results on the 

ErgData app:
https://workout.ergdata.com/shared/jbqpxqej

workouts.title: Bench Press
workouts.description:
Bench Press

3x10 @ // RPE 6

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:00 between sets.
- These sets should feel light. Try to keep a lot of control on the way down, and feel free to add in a pause at the chest for all or some of the reps.

workouts.title: Dumbbell Bench Press
workouts.description:
Dumbbell Bench Press

4x15 @ RPE 6

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:00 between reps.
- Keep control on the way down and be explosive on the way up.
- Use weights that allow you to consistently stay unbroken with no breaks or pauses in your cadence.

workouts.title: Extra/ Accessory:
workouts.description:
EMOM 6
:30 Front Plank Shoulder Taps

NOTES:
- Try to hold as tight of a body position as possible, staying braced with the abs in toward the spine and not allowing the hips to rock from side to side.

workouts.title: Skill
workouts.description:
EMOM 10:
10 Burpee Box Jump Over @24"/20"

NOTES:
- The goal is to move at the hardest sustainable pace across each set.
- Make an effort to keep your footwork and movement consistent for each minute.
- Take note of your average time to complete each set.
- This was last programmed on April 21st, 2025. Refer back to your notes from then if you did this session.

workouts.title: Warm up:
workouts.description:
3 Sets:
15/12 Cal Fan Bike
5 Straight Leg Box Jump
10/10 Half Kneeling Single Arm Strict Press
:30 Mountain Climber

workouts.title: Power Jerk
workouts.description:
EMOM 6
2 Power Jerk @  RPE 6-7

NOTES:
- Use this opportunity to practice your technique on the power jerk.
- Be sure your footwork is consistent for each rep.

workouts.title: Strict Press
workouts.description:
Strict Press:

4x5 @ 65-70% // RPE 7

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:00 between sets.
- These sets should give some challenge for five reps, but still allow for consistent movement each time. Scale back the weight if needed.
- Reset in the front rack with each rep (i.e. don't bounce the bar off of the shoulders).

2-2-2-3 Minutes Work / 1:00 Rest

2 Rope Climb
15/12 Cal Fan Bike
Max Rep Handstand Push-Up *

NOTES:
- This piece will be 2:00 of working time for the first three sets, then 3:00 of working time for the fourth set. Always rest for 1:00 between sets.
- The rope climbs should be completed under :40 each round. If you don't have rope climbs, check out the Substitutions & Scaling Guide in Circle: https:// hwpo-training.circle.so/c/resources-842857/
substitutions-scaling
- Aim to finish the calories always under :50. Adjust the calories if needed.
* If you can consistently complete sets of ten or more handstand push-ups unbroken, look to make this movement more difficult for this AMRAP by either subbing in strict reps or adding in a deficit.

workouts.title: ACCESSORY / EXTRA
workouts.description:
A) Single Arm Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
4x12/12 @ RPE 6

NOTES:
- Rest at least :30 between arms and 1:00 between
sets.
- Choose a weight that gives minimal challenge to complete 12 unbroken reps each time.
----

B) Accumulate 3:00 in a Sorenson Hold, For Quality.
NOTES:
- Keep the glutes squeezed and hold as tight a body position as possible.
- Cut this piece off at 6:00, if needed.

workouts.title: Zone 2
workouts.description:
55:00 Zone 2 Spin Bike, Run, or Stairmaster

NOTES:
- If possible, wear a heart rate monitor so you can accurately gauge your zone 2 heart rate.

workouts.title: Warm up:
workouts.description:
3 Sets:
15/12 Cal Row
6/6 Single Arm Dumbbell Overhead Squat (RPE 6)
10 Sots Press (w/ Empty Barbell)
20 Heels Over DB-KB

workouts.title: Overhead Squat
workouts.description:
Overhead Squat

1x6 @ 50% // RPE 5-6
1x6 @ 60% // RPE 6
1x6 @ 50% // RPE 5-6

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:30 between each set.
- These sets are lighter in order to deload this week.
If you feel good, feel free to add in a controlled descent and a small pause on some or all of these
reps.

workouts.title: Squat Snatch
workouts.description:
EMOM 9:

1 Squat Snatch @70% // RPE 7

NOTES:
- The weight used for this EMOM should allow you to focus on perfect speed and positioning for each rep.
Aim to be consistent in your set-up and your technique.
- If you feel good, feel free to add a small pause in the receiving position of each rep.

workouts.title: Snatch Pull From Knee Height
workouts.description:
Snatch Pull From Knee Height

3x4 @ 90% // RPE 8

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:30 between sets.
- Set up your plates on jerk blocks or a stack of plates so that your bar is set to knee height for each rep.
- Reset the bar between reps. These should not be touch-and-go reps.

workouts.title: METCON
workouts.description:
"1/2 Triple Three"
For Time:
1500m Row
150 Double Under
1.5 - Mile Run

Time Cap: 30 Minutes
NOTES:
- This is a long workout, so aim to pace things from the start. Somewhere between 02:05 - 02:08/500m is a good pace to start.
- Try to empty the tank on the run for the last 400-800m.

workouts.title: ACCESSORY / EXTRA
workouts.description:
A) Bodyweight Lunge to Step-Up"
4x10/10 @ 24/20"

NOTES:
- Rest at least :30 between legs and 1:00 between sets.
- Drive the knee of the nonworking leg up at the top of each rep.
- Scale back the height of the box if needed to maintain control of each rep.


B) EMOM 8:
1: :30 Hollow Rock
2: 10/10 Side Plank Hip Touch

NOTES:
- Aim to move with control, not necessarily speed, for both of these movements.
- Cut the working time/reps down if needed to maintain quality.

workouts.title: Gymnastics Skill Work.
workouts.description:
Gymnastics Skill Work

Every 2:00 × 10:00... (5 Sets)
6-10 Toes to Bar
4-8 Chest to Bar
2-6 Bar Muscle-Up

NOTES:
- Choose a number of reps for each movement that gives you a chance of going unbroken each time. As an extra challenge, try to stay on the bar between movements for unbroken sets.
- If you don't have these skills nailed down to complete unbroken reps at the minimum numbers, sub in 5-10:00 of practice on any of these skills.

workouts.title: Warm up:
workouts.description:
3 Sets:
15/12 Cal Fan Bike
50 Single Under
20 Band Pull Apart
:30/:30 Side Plank

workouts.title: Back Squat
workouts.description:
Back Squat
3x3 @ 72% // RPE 6

NOTES:
- Rest at least 2:00 between sets.
- If you feel good with the listed weight, feel free to add in a small pause at the bottom of each rep.

workouts.title: Front Squat
workouts.description:
Front Squat:

3x5 @ 65 % // RPE 6

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:30 between sets.
- Focus on having a controlled descent, then as much speed as possible on the way up from each rep.

workouts.title: Metcon:
workouts.description:
For Time:

40-30-20-10
Alternating Dumbbell Snatch @22.5/15kg
Wall Ball @ 14/9kg | 10/9ft

Time Cap: 14 Minutes

NOTES:
- The reps descend with each round, but this still totals out to one hundred reps per movement. The load for both movements should allow for consistent sets of ten or more unbroken reps. Decrease the weight of the dumbbell or medicine ball if needed.
- As a focus point, try to transition between movements or sets with less than :10 of rest each time.

workouts.title: ACCESSORY / EXTRA
workouts.description:
A) Band Assisted Strict Chest to Bar
4x(10-15)

NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:00 between sets.
- Use band(s) to allow for at least 10 unbroken reps each time.

B) Dumbbell Bicep Curl
2x20 @ RPE 7
NOTES:
- Rest at least 1:00 between sets.
- Focus on keeping your movement entirely at the elbows.

workouts.title: Row Intervals.
workouts.description:
Row Intervals.
3 Sets:
5:00 Row @ 02:15/500m; 22 S/M
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.
+
Rest 3:00
+
3 Sets:
5:00 Row @ 02:09/500m; 26 S/M
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- Use the first three sets to start off implementing good stroke technique and power per stroke. Then, as the stroke rate increases, focus on maintaining power and technique, and increasing the rate at which you recover back into the machine to reach 26 S/M.
- If you are short on time, feel free to cut off one set per section for a total of four sets.
- If you are using a PM5 monitor, use this link to set your erg and track your results on the
 ErgData app:
https://workout.ergdata.com/shared/wkju2ggu

+

6/6 Single Arm Dumbbell Upright Row (RPE 5)
10 GHD Back Extension

workouts.title: Power Clean + Push Jerk
workouts.description:
Power Clean + Push Jerk

EMOM 12:
1+1 @75% // RPE 8

NOTES:
- Take a moment to pause at the top of the clean before the jerk. Be sure the grip and stance are where they should be, the core is braced, and then initiate the dip.

workouts.title: Deadlift
workouts.description:
Deadlift: 
1x5 @ 55%// RPE 6
1x5 @ 66% // RPE 6.5
1x5 @ 77% // RPE 7

NOTES:
- Rest at least 2:00 between sets.
- Perform these as "deadstop" reps, i.e. reset the bar at the ground between reps.

workouts.title: Conditioning
workouts.description:
EMOM 28
1: 16/13 Cal Fan Bike
2: 50ft Handstand Walk
3: 10 Deadlift @100/70kg + Max Rep Bar Facing Burpee
4: Rest

NOTES:
- It is okay if the fan bike takes slightly longer than it does on your standard EMOM 40. Cap the fan bike at :50 each round.
- The handstand walk should also be completed under :50 each time. Scale to 3-5 Wall Walk if needed.
- The deadlifts should be in two sets or unbroken each time. Scale to 49.5kg if needed.

workouts.title: Extra/ Accessory:
workouts.description:
A) Accumulate 100 Banded Good Morning, For Quality.
NOTES:
- Use a band that would allow for at least 15 unbroken reps each time.
- Be sure you are moving with enough control to feel the posterior chain working on each rep.

B) 10 Sets:
:30 Dumbbell Farmer's Carry @ 2x70/50lb I
2x32.5/22.5kg
*Rest :30 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- If at any point you cannot keep to the :30 carry with :30 rests, then add a 2:00 rest period to allow more recovery and then try to then go back for :30/:30.
- If you feel confident you could complete this unbroken, feel free to bump up to heavier kettlebells.
